book.name: Sarenta halomang-halomang
book.title: Sarenta Halomang-Halomang Lahatala Ana por-alolang bot burang ening

content: Sodom enehe ang naung ijasi-iahala

Uanguveng Lahatala Ana jedung Abraham at mateng sehi se, Egahingvala aaru angu, ini lamal milalut ila bendar Sodom mi. Ini ila bendar Sodom mi se, ved hula baa. Uanguveng angu, Lot ana jedung ue bendar Sodom eviaha maso eele angumi mihi sehi.
Lot ana uuling nehe aaru angu iateing muse, ana lamal va ing sambut. Angmuse Lot ana nehe aaru angu iapangaadang mi kuku muding.

Lot ana nehe aaru angu iat mateng hula, “Nimang iimal! Mahe, iini nehava mi miaarit jar metma iia laming, senge bir-kua anga iini angami tia. Tobang kuaveng senge, iini lamal milalu.” Aarunge nehe aaru angu ini Lot ehur angu ebalet hula, “Niang! Vede bir-kua anga, ni bendar anga elapang mi tia.”
Aarunge Lot ana iasenang alolang-niang, angmuse ini ila ehava mi mihit vengtahang. Angmuse Lot ana roti ba bae bibit maveng niang angu iia, sengmuse ini adang hama-hama.
Nehe aaru angu bae tia jedung se, bendar Sodom enehe mehal ang naung, boma-kuar, nu bae ihava mi mihi niang, aarunge emangpi hoa Lot ehava angu goleng tahi.
Ini moring Lot adangtaaning hula, “Ee, Lot! Nehe mehal aaru vede angu, ini ue taang mi? Iat kaluar hela angami, senge ni hula iat tia!”
Angmuse Lot ana kaluar hela viaha mi ing harak, aarunge ana amotaoa angmi tundil angu vengtering.
Lot ana Sodom enehe ang naung iat mateng hula, “Kaku naung! Iini ekang jasi ening metma nehe aaru angu iadana ekang.

Iini ateing se, noal jangu aaru angu, nehe mehal bae ing dei di jedung. Base, kalo iini vengjali se, biar oleve na iat kaluar hela metma maiinang, senge iini naba ba ening metma iadana di aaung. Aarunge iini ekang naiiba ening metma nehe aaru angu iadana ekang. Se pihada eamulung se, na malekang ing jagat aaung-aaung angu ebele.”

Aarunge Sodom enehe ang naung ini moring hula, “Aana ekang nehe aaru angu ing tahang ekang! Aaing angu nehe hoang-manang ba ae angami! Aaing nehe aabeung, base aana ekang ning vengator ekang. Aaungba aana tahit lamal mana anga eahalang. Angase ni aaing ening lebe mitamadi nehe aaru angu mi iataangoa!” Angmuse nehe mehal ang naung ini Lot atobang, ini hama-hamat va hula tundil angu jambat ening ajasing.
Aarunge nehe aaru Lot ehava mi angu, ini iatang taning hela Lot aing masiring hava omimi maso, sengmuse ini tundil angu vengtering.
Angmuse nehe aaru angu ini Sodom enehe ba hava eviaha mi ang naung, boma-kuar, emangpi ieng angu ening akete, angu ebele ini hava eviaha valaping di, bae harak niang.
Lahatala ana Lot iimal iat lamal kaluar bendar Sodom eahalang

Angmuse nehe aaru angu ini Lot at mateng hula, “Lot! Eenehe aabeung taang ba jedung ae bendar anga mi? Kalo ooal mehal, ooal jangu, iidat mehal, iidat jangu, bot nuba-nuba di, aaungba aana iat lamal kaluar, mana anga eahalang! Angase ni hula mana anga ening amusing-ajela. Bau-pei toang LAHATALA Apangaadang mi, metma bendar anga adana tila. Angu ebele LAHATALA Ana ning gahing niot ening amusing-ajela!”

Angmuse Lot ana kaluar ila nehe mehal aaru ba hula, oal jangu aaru angu medi angu ing harak. Lot ana iat mateng hula, “Vengmeet aaung-aaung! Angase aaungba iini tahit lamal kaluar mana anga eahalang, se LAHATALA Ana hula bendar anga ening amusing-ajela angu ebele!” Aarunge nehe mehal aaru angu ini hula, Lot ana mang mamulal mateng.

Emikuaveng vedeng hula da muse, Lahatala Egahingvala aaru angu, ini Lot aing paksa, senge ini uuser lamal kaluar. Ini Lot at mateng hula, “Lot! Aaungba tahit eejangu, bot ooal jangu aaru angu, iat lamal kaluar, senge iini ekang bendar anga enehe ba jasi-ahala ang naung iat hama-hamat aamina ekang.”

Uanguveng Lot jedung pati-pati sehi, aarunge LAHATALA Ana hula ing ening lohi. Angu ebele Lahatala Egahingvala aaru angu ini Lot atang, ejangu atang, bot oal jangu aaru angu iatang angu vengpina, sengmuse iat lamal kaluar bendar angu eahalang.

Kaluar ila bendar angu eahalang muse, Lahatala Egahingvala aaru angu, nu Lot at mateng hula, “Uuser bihi, senge iini bisa lohi! Ekang bale iiamota oat uuling ekang! Bot ekang kakura-omi ba Yordan moar mi angu mi barinti ekang. Bihit lalut ila dol angdo taang, senge iini ekang aamina ekang!”
Aarunge Lot ana ebalet hula, “Adoo, nimang! Ekang aulang ekang!
Nimang aana etatabit ning ening lohi tila. Aarunge dol angdo etatabit ola! Misavaka ni bae ila angdo mi jedung se, aaminang angu via mi ning harak, base ning di aamina.
Aabang nu moe angmomi angmo, bae ola niang. Aabang angu kiki nu. Base kalo nimang aana jali se, ni bihit aabang angmomi ila, senge ni ekang aamina ekang.”
Angmuse Lahatala Egahingvala angu ana Lot at mateng hula, “Yoo! Aana banang aulang base, Aabang ba aana vengbanang angu, eningse na bae ening amusing-ajela niang.

Base, iini uuser bihit angmomi ila! Iini bae ila aabang angmomi jedung se, na bae na iiba ening jedung.” Mulai uanguveng angmuse, aabang angu nehe ene maveng hula, Soar, evengbanang tarang se hula, ꞌkikiꞌ.
Bendar Sodom, bot Gomora viling musi-jelat miosing
Uanguveng vedeng da iila muse, Lot iimal bihit ila Soar aabang mi tila.
Mibaroti se, LAHATALA Ana aad huring, bot balirang tutung burang mi, metma bendar Sodom, bot Gomora vengbokong hela.

Bendar, bot aabang ba ue kakura-omi Yordan moar eoang mi ang naung, emangpi LAHATALA Ana ening amusing-ajela, bot ening midodu-milala. Bot emangpi ba angumi aabeta angu, benangba: manusia, binanta, bot dadi-napa, bot te ang naung, emangpi viling musi-jelat miosing.
Aarunge uanguveng Lot iimal bihit ila hula iava ening lohi angu, Lot ejangu ana bale amotaoat uuling. Angmuse aing metma iihal-eera ening.
Emikuaveng muse, Abraham ana bale ila mana ba uanguveng ana mi tahit LAHATALA Asenang angu mi,

sengmuse ana eng metma bendar Sodom, bot Gomora, bot kakura-omi Yordan moar eoang mi angu euuling se, taang-taang mi angu, aad-banak oopol-oopol mida burang mi. Bot emangpi angu, viling musi-jelat miosing iila.

Uanguveng Lahatala Ana bendar ba kakura-omi Yordan moar eoang mi, bot bendar ba Lot emihing mana ang naung ening amusing-ajela angu, palai ba Lahatala Ana metma Abraham at palai angu, Ana vengani. Angu ebele, Lahatala Ana Lot at lamal kaluar metma bendar ba Ana ening amusing-ajela, bot ening midodu-milala angu eahalang.
Lot, bot oal jangu aaru angu
Uanguveng Lot ana Soar aabang mi angu uangmari. Angu ebele aing, bot oal jangu aaru angu, ini iava asorong ila dol taang. Angmuse ini angumi pa nu mi mihi.
Minu adana, jangu emutu angu ana ekaku iia angu at hubait hula, “Kaku! Timang ana boma tila, bot mana anga mi anga, nehe mehal iiba bae bisa pibele hoa senge ping medi niang.
Base lebe miaaung pi anggur metma timang enang ana na, sampe veng naboa, senge pi abung tia. Aulang senge, pi bisa timang etabaning angu hamua.”

Angmuse bir-kua angu, oleve anggur metma imang enang ana na, sampe naboa. Sengmuse jangu emutu angu ana masot mida imang abung tia. Aarunge boma Lot ana etatabit naboa, base naba ba ana ening metma oal jangu adana tila angu, ana bae vengkaruang niang.

Emitobang muse, jangu emutu angu ana bot ekaku iia angu at hubait hula, “Kaku! Vede bir-kua angu, na timang abung tia tila. Angu ebele, misabantar bir-kua anga di, pi anggur metma timang enang ana na, senge aana masot mida abung tia. Aulang senge, pi bisa timang etabaning angu hamua.”

Base, bir-kua angu di ini ening imang ana naboa, sengmuse jangu iia angu ana masot mida imang abung tia. Aarunge boma Lot ana etatabit naboa, base naba ba ana ening metma oal jangu adana tila angu, ana bae vengkaruang niang.
Ening aulang, base Lot oal jangu aaru angu iatou veng.

Jangu emutu angu ana vaal mehal nu vengajai muse, ana ene maveng, ene Moab (emenghula hur kokal aabeung nu angu edadenang, evengbanang tarang se hula, ꞌimang abung hoaꞌ). Aingba Moab enehe ang naung idat-imang.
Angmuse jangu iia angu di, ana vaal mehal nu vengajai. Ana ene maveng, ene Ben Ami (evengbanang tarang se hula, ꞌvaal nenehe abung hoaꞌ). Aingba Amon enehe ang naung, idat-imang.

footnotes.text: Tura-tura angu, bendar eviaha maso eele angu, nehe boma ang naung ini angumi mihit parkara vengputus, bot ini angumi mihit mamateng.
Mivea muse, Moab enehe, bot Amon enehe ang naung, ini Israel enehe ang naung, ing ening susa-lalat alolang-niang.
